method: Exact span+type micro precision/recall/F1. Partial spans count as FP and FN in strict metrics. One-to-one exact, then same-type overlap, then wrong-type overlap diagnostics. Scope filtering is explicit; raw unfiltered predictions remain in results files.
hybridMethod: Installed ko-pii merge_detections ROLE_SPLIT with explicit PERSON or PERSON+ADDRESS only; no app change. Secondary PERSON risk HIGH, ADDRESS MEDIUM, matching installed adapter.
nativePIIPolicy: All native PII predictions count, including labels outside the 16 gold types; A explicitly non-PII DATE/TIME/QUANTITY/PLACE/ORGANIZATION are excluded. A ATTRIBUTE and B SENSITIVE_ATTR remain visible, not interpreted as specific HEIGHT/WEIGHT. Rule VEHICLE is canonically mapped to PLATE. This is policy-scoped, not a test of every supported label.
